blue_card.name: EU Blue Card
blue_card.explanationTemplate: With your {{degreeField}} degree and €{{salary}} offer, you may qualify for the EU Blue Card.

skilled_worker.name: Skilled Worker Visa
skilled_worker.explanationTemplate: With your {{degreeField}} qualification and {{experienceYears}} years of experience, you're eligible for the Skilled Worker Visa.

it_specialist.name: IT Specialist Visa (Without Degree)
it_specialist.explanationTemplate: With {{experienceYears}} years of IT experience and a €{{salary}} offer, you qualify for the IT Specialist Visa even without a formal degree.

job_seeker.name: Job Seeker Visa
job_seeker.explanationTemplate: With your recognized {{degreeField}} degree and {{experienceYears}} years of experience, you qualify for a Job Seeker Visa to search for employment in Germany for up to 6 months.

student.name: Student Visa
student.explanationTemplate: With your admission to study {{studyField}}, you qualify for a Student Visa.

language_course.name: Language Course Visa
language_course.explanationTemplate: Since you plan to attend a full-time German language course, you may qualify for a Language Course Visa.

ausbildung.name: Ausbildung (Vocational Training) Visa
ausbildung.explanationTemplate: With a vocational training contract in {{degreeField}}, you qualify for an Ausbildung visa.

researcher.name: Researcher Visa
researcher.explanationTemplate: With your hosting agreement from a German research institution, you're eligible for a Researcher Visa.

artist.name: Artist/Performer Visa
artist.explanationTemplate: As an artist with {{performanceCount}} scheduled performances, you may qualify for a cultural visa.

athlete.name: Professional Athlete/Coach Visa
athlete.explanationTemplate: As a professional athlete with a contract from a German sports club, you qualify for an athlete visa.

esports.name: Esports Professional Visa
esports.explanationTemplate: As a professional esports player with a German organization contract, you may qualify for a professional visa.

language_teacher.name: Language Teacher Visa
language_teacher.explanationTemplate: As a certified language teacher with an employment contract, you qualify for a professional visa.

freelance.name: Freelance/Self-Employment Visa (Freiberufler)
freelance.explanationTemplate: With your {{degreeField}} background and business plan in {{businessSector}}, you may qualify for a freelance visa.

family_reunion.name: Family Reunion Visa
family_reunion.explanationTemplate: Since you have family legally residing in Germany, you may qualify for Family Reunion.

au_pair.name: Au Pair Visa
au_pair.explanationTemplate: With a host family contract, you qualify for an Au Pair Visa.

volunteer_service.name: Volunteer Service Visa (FSJ/BFD)
volunteer_service.explanationTemplate: With your volunteer program contract, you're eligible for a Volunteer Service visa.

working_holiday.name: Working Holiday Visa
working_holiday.explanationTemplate: As a {{nationality}} national aged {{age}}, you qualify for the Working Holiday Visa.
